Initial release of Markdown Editor With: Convert Markdown Into Videos.

- Instantly convert markdown scripts (with headers, bullet points) into 1080p video slides.
- Simple, fast workflow: drag-and-drop markdown, describe the result, get a downloadable video in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session/token setup — free 7-day, 100-credit tokens on first use.
- Supports export in mp4, mov, avi, webm, and more via a cloud rendering backend.
- Clear feedback for state, credits, export, and upload, plus translated error/GUI messages.
